name: Campus Chemistry Lab Renovation
brief: Renovate the second-floor chemistry teaching lab during the winter term. Strip the old fittings, remove two partition walls, rewire the lab with new power and data points, add plumbing for wet-lab sinks, install fume-hood ducting and fire safety, lay anti-static vinyl flooring, fit a false ceiling with LED lighting, and install new benches and storage. Needs a building permit and a fire inspection before handover. In-house works team plus contracted trades; the department wants the lab back for the new term, about fourteen weeks.

tasks.name: Electrical wiring and lab power points
Snag fixes and handover to department

risks.title: Building permit delayed
risks.cause: The estate office reviews permits only at its fortnightly meeting
risks.event: The permit misses a meeting or comes back with queries
risks.effect: Demolition and all site work start late
risks.response: Pre-review the drawings with the estate office before formal submission

risks.title: Hidden structural problem behind partitions
risks.cause: The building is old and its as-built drawings are incomplete
risks.event: Demolition exposes a damaged lintel or embedded services
risks.effect: Demolition pauses for an engineer's assessment and repair
risks.response: Open inspection holes in both partitions during the site survey

risks.title: Old wiring needs full replacement
risks.cause: The existing conduits are corroded and undersized for lab loads
risks.event: The electrician finds the conduits cannot be reused
risks.effect: Rewiring takes longer and needs more material
risks.response: Price full replacement as an option in the electrical quote

risks.title: Vinyl flooring delivery late
risks.cause: Anti-static vinyl is imported and stocked by one distributor
risks.event: The flooring arrives after the floor is ready
risks.effect: Flooring and everything after it slip
risks.response: Place the flooring order as soon as the layout is approved and confirm the ship date

risks.title: Mason crew shortage
risks.cause: Contract masons are in demand on other campus jobs in winter
risks.event: Only part of the mason crew turns up for two weeks
risks.response: Agree crew size and a daily penalty in the masonry contract

risks.title: Department changes the bench layout
risks.cause: Faculty review the layout only after fabrication starts
risks.event: The department asks for different bench heights and storage
risks.response: Get a signed layout from the head of department before fabrication

risks.title: Debris removal restricted to weekends
risks.cause: Classes run in the same building during the term
risks.event: Security limits debris removal to off-hours
risks.response: Book the service lift and a skip for evening slots in advance

risks.title: Fire inspection fails first time
risks.cause: Fume-hood ducting and extinguisher placement follow a new code
risks.effect: Rework and a second inspection are needed
risks.response: Run a mock inspection with the campus fire officer after ducting is done

risks.title: Sink plumbing fails the leak test
risks.cause: Chemical-resistant pipe joints are new to the plumbing team
risks.event: Joints leak under the pressure test
risks.response: Have the supplier's technician supervise the first joints
